org.eclipse.dirigible:dirigible-components-core-liquibase 14.20.0 发布, Source of truth for the Dirigible system schema (DIRIGIBLE_*) running in SystemDB.
        Liquibase JSON changelogs in src/main/resources/db/changelog/ create and version every
        platform table; Hibernate is reduced to schema validation (DIRIGIBLE_DATABASE_SYSTEM_DDL_AUTO
        defaults to "validate") and no longer issues DDL during application startup.
        Dynamic user entities (TypeScript @Entity via data-store, Java @Entity via
        data-store-java) continue to use Hibernate's hbm2ddl=update because their schema is
        authored by end-user code, not by changelogs.

items.title:
app.doqa:doqa-client 0.1.3 发布, Reusable JVM client core for the DoQA Autotest API: configuration resolution
        (system properties over environment over properties file), model builders serializing
        to the API contract, an HTTP client with token auth, retries and timeouts,
        run-selection modes, and an Allure-compatible file sink. No runtime dependencies:
        HTTP via java.net.http (JDK 11+), JSON via a small built-in codec, so any
        test-framework adapter can build on top of it.

com.kohlschutter.junixsocket:junixsocket 2.11.0 发布, junixsocket is a Java/JNI library that allows the use of Unix Domain Sockets (AF_UNIX sockets) and other socket types, such as AF_TIPC and AF_VSOCK, from Java.

In contrast to other implementations, junixsocket extends the Java Sockets API (java.net.Socket, java.net.SocketAddress etc.) and even supports RMI over AF_UNIX. It is also possible to use it in conjunction with Connector/J to connect to a local MySQL server via Unix domain sockets.

items.title:
eu.ciechanowiec:airness-assets 1.0.2 发布, The files the harness owns but cannot supply from a classpath, and the manifest saying what a
        project may do with each.

        Most of the harness reaches a project as configuration an analyzer reads off its own plugin
        classpath, which is why most of it needs no file in the project at all. What lands here is what
        something outside Maven reads from disk: an editor reading .editorconfig, git reading
        .gitattributes. Those have nowhere else to live, so they live in the project and are checked
        against the bytes shipped here.

        Each canonical file is stored under an added .asset suffix. A stored .gitignore under its own
        name would be a working .gitignore over this directory and could stop its neighbours from being
        tracked, and a stored .gitattributes would take effect over them. A file that changes the meaning
        of the directory it sits in cannot be stored under its own name.

items.content_text:
eu.ciechanowiec:airness-assets 1.0.2 发布, The files the harness owns but cannot supply from a classpath, and the manifest saying what a
        project may do with each.

        Most of the harness reaches a project as configuration an analyzer reads off its own plugin
        classpath, which is why most of it needs no file in the project at all. What lands here is what
        something outside Maven reads from disk: an editor reading .editorconfig, git reading
        .gitattributes. Those have nowhere else to live, so they live in the project and are checked
        against the bytes shipped here.

        Each canonical file is stored under an added .asset suffix. A stored .gitignore under its own
        name would be a working .gitignore over this directory and could stop its neighbours from being
        tracked, and a stored .gitattributes would take effect over them. A file that changes the meaning
        of the directory it sits in cannot be stored under its own name.
